title: Code and run logs for: Correcting a merit proxy for measurement error does not close the sex gap in income audits
description: Analysis code and run logs for a study that asks whether correcting a schooling proxy for measurement error closes the sex gap in income audits across 250 United States state-year markets, and finds that it does not. The raw inputs (American Community Survey PUMS files and the PIAAC Cycle 2 United States public-use file) are not redistributed; the fetchers included in the release obtain them from their original servers.
